responsibility: Implements the post-allocation stack-register conversion pass for targets with stack-like FP registers, notably the x87. It transforms GCC’s flat RTL view of stack-class registers into explicit stack semantics by assigning actual stack positions, inserting exchanges/pushes/pops and compensation code on edges, rebuilding stack-related REG_DEAD/REG_UNUSED behavior, handling asm constraints for stack operands, and adjusting CFG as needed. This pass is specific to converting allocated RTL into stack-register form after ordinary register allocation is complete.
